VAL-INSP-001.notes: Inspiration cards show a '...' (MoreVertical) button on hover in the top-right corner. Clicking it opens a dropdown with 'View Details' and 'Delete'. Right-clicking the card (via contextmenu event) opens the same context menu with 'View Details' and 'Delete'. No console errors.

VAL-INSP-002.notes: Selecting 'Delete' from the inspiration card dropdown opens a confirmation dialog: 'Delete inspiration - Are you sure you want to delete this inspiration? This action cannot be undone.' with Cancel and Delete buttons. Tested on the last visible card ('From Zero To Hero') to avoid interfering with other validators. Cancelled to preserve data.

VAL-VID-001.notes: Right-clicking a VideoCard (via contextmenu event) opens a context menu with 'Edit' and 'Delete' options, matching the existing '...' dropdown items. No console errors.

VAL-PERS-001.notes: Person cards show a '...' (MoreVertical) button on hover in the top-right corner. Right-clicking the card (via contextmenu event) opens a context menu with 'Edit' and 'Delete' options. No console errors.

VAL-PERS-002.notes: Selecting 'Delete' from the person card dropdown opens a confirmation dialog: 'Delete person - Are you sure you want to delete "Melvyn"? This action cannot be undone.' with Cancel and Delete buttons. Tested on the last person card ('Melvyn') to avoid interfering with other validators. Cancelled to preserve data.

VAL-CROSS-001.notes: All four listing pages use the same visual pattern: '...' (MoreVertical) button on hover in the top-right corner of cards + right-click context menu. Both the dropdown and context menu show the same actions per page. Thumbnails: Rename/Delete. Inspirations: View Details/Delete. Videos: Edit/Delete. Persons: Edit/Delete. The visual pattern (button position, menu style, icon usage) is consistent across all pages.

frictions.description: The provided signed cookie value used base64url encoding (with _ and - characters, no padding) but Better Auth expects standard base64 encoding (with / and + characters, = padding). This caused auth failures until the correct encoding was discovered by running the test-sign-cookie.mjs script.
frictions.resolution: Regenerated the signed cookie using standard base64 encoding: token.btoa(HMAC-SHA-256(secret, token)) instead of base64url

frictions.description: agent-browser cookies set requires --url flag (not --domain/--path) when setting cookies before page load, and needs --httpOnly flag for Better Auth session cookies
frictions.resolution: Used: agent-browser cookies set name value --url http://localhost:3001 --httpOnly
